items.title: Muse Now Available in the UK: Muse Does the Work, You Stay in Control
items.what_happened: Muse, Meta’s personal AI agent, is now available to adults in the UK. Think of it as a helping hand for the jobs that pile up, like chasing a refund, renewing car insurance or keeping on top of the school calendar. To get those jobs done you can connect Muse to the apps you already use, from your email and calendar to the retailer apps you shop on.
